ops.body: Correction to the investigation record: four of the five slash-command wrappers were ALREADY matched by STRUCTURAL_TAG_GROUP (group `xml_tags`) via `local-command-(?:stdout|caveat)` and `command-(?:name|message|args)` — the investigation's literal grep missed the alternation. The real gaps were (1) `local-command-stderr` missing from that alternation, and (2) SENTIMENT_JUNK_GROUPS / JUNK_USER_MESSAGE_RE being DEAD in the sentiment path (bucket_events kept every UserEvent, so all protocol noise was scored). Both fixed in commit 6c73625d: added `stderr` to xml_tags, folded COMMAND_ECHO_GROUPS into SENTIMENT_JUNK_GROUPS, and wired JUNK_USER_MESSAGE_RE into bucket_events (dropping junk turns before MIN_USER_TURNS counting so they neither reach the model nor pad eligibility). No Rust change: patterns ride the JSON spec contract; xml_tags and command_echo are already in PORTABLE_GROUP_NAMES; generated protocol.rs holds only the text-layer constants.
